static.solution:
(a) If y is constant, we get z = 9 y^2 + a, for some value of a, so that the cross-sections are upward-opening parabolas.
(b) If x is constant, we get z = -3 x^2 + a, for some value of a, so that the cross-sections are downward-opening parabolas.
(c) If z is constant and equal to 5, we get y = \pm \sqrt{3} x, which are two intersecting straight lines.
